_comment: Starting-point day-rate card used only when Revenue Hunter has not already estimated a real figure in pipeline.json. Every figure this produces is labelled 'rate-card-estimate' and flagged to confirm before sending — adjust the numbers below to reflect actual rates; no code change is needed.

Fractional Retainer._note: AOS Sprint 12 — Commercial Options' Retainer option; same day rate as Consulting Project, framed as an ongoing monthly commitment rather than a fixed-scope project.

Grant.note: Grant-funded; price per the grant's own terms, not a day rate.

Partnership.note: Revenue-share or co-delivery; price per the partnership's own terms, not a day rate.

Product Idea.note: Productised offer; price per unit or licence, not a day rate.

effortAdjustment._note: scores.timeRequired (0-10, inverted) >= lowEffortThreshold scales the estimate down (fast-converting); below highOverheadThreshold scales it up (long-running).
